text:
Type: geometric wool area rug
Use: softening a floor by a bed or sofa; bedroom, living room, home office
Style: coastal, modern, contemporary
Materials: wool, textured pile with sketched pattern
Colors: ivory white, soft light blue
Shape: rectangular, repeating chevron and diamond lattice in hand-drawn lines, medium size, light visual weight
Feel: fresh, airy, calm
Goes with: light wood floors, teal or white walls, blue accents; coastal or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Geometric Wool Area Rug, 4 x 6 Foot, Blue
product.description: 80% Wool 20% Cotton Imported The cool tones of this bold, geometric rug pulls any space together effortlessly. Hand-woven, 100% wool fibers add lasting style and comfort. Area rug features a mesmerizing geometric print. Hand-tufted. Low .3'' pile suits high-traffic, transitional indoor areas. Pair with a rug pad (sold separately). 4' x 6' Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag.
